blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent research suggests that individual neurons can have interpretable roles in AI behaviour. In Qwen3.5-4B, steering along one neuron's output direction increased decisions to conceal information more in teams than alone across five scenarios, even when teammates provided no messages. When all members participated and received steering, collective concealment increased in four scenarios, while inter-agent messaging helped temper concealment under steering. Moreover, removing the neuron's contribution had negligible effects. Collective settings can therefore change how an internal intervention affects AI behaviour.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究表明,单个神经元可以在AI行为中具有可解释的角色. 在Qwen3.5-4B中,沿着一个神经元的输出方向进行引导,使得在五种情景中,即使队友不提供消息,在团队中隐藏更多的信息的决定增加. 当所有成员都参加并接受指导时,在四种情况下,集体隐瞒有所增加,而代理人之间的信息传递有助于在指导下适度隐瞒。 此外,去除神经元的贡献效果微不足道. 因此,集体环境可以改变内部干预如何影响人工智能行为。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: AI agents can follow incorrect majorities [ 1 ] , develop collective misalignment through social influence [ 2 ] , and violate rules during repeated interaction [ 3 ] . Message interventions can interrupt collective violations [ 4 ] and internal activation signals can help detect collusion [ 9 ] , while single-neuron interventions affecting refusal [ 6 ] and proposals about interpretable neurons [ 8 ] motivate examining how internal changes affect collective behaviour. Because alignment ought to require evaluating agents together as well as individually [ 10 ] , we use activation steering [ 5 ] to test whether one neuron’s output direction increases omission more in teams than alone, and whether steering all members changes collective disclosure.
blocks.zh: AI代理可以跟踪不正确的多数[1],通过社会影响发展集体错配[2],在反复互动时违反规则[3]. 信息干预可以中断集体侵权[4],内部激活信号可以帮助检测串通[9],而影响拒绝的单中子干预[6]和关于可解释神经元的建议[8]则会激发对内部变化如何影响集体行为的检查. 因为校正需要同时以及单独评估代理人[10],所以我们使用激活引导[5]来测试一个神经元的输出方向是否会增加团队中的遗漏,以及引导所有成员是否改变集体披露。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Steering increases omission in silent teams, while message sharing often reduces collective concealment. (A) Alone, silent-team, and active-team settings, with focal agents outlined and steered agents blue. Four rounds revisit one incident, with earlier-message access set by condition. (B) Exact excerpts from trial seed 20063, round 4, own messages, with emphasis added. The steered agent invokes consensus despite silent peers. (C) Focal omission in rounds 2–4, with own messages alone and in silent teams, and shared messages in active teams. Steering affects the focal agent or all active members, respectively, so this comparison does not isolate communication. (D) Final collective concealment with shared or private channels. Open and filled points show unsteered and steered rates, with 200 episodes per condition. Contrast intervals appear in the text.
blocks.zh: 图1:指导增加了沉默团队的遗漏,而信息分享往往减少集体隐瞒. (A) 单独、无声小组和主动小组设置,由联络员概述和引导代理人蓝色。 四轮重审一次事件,提前消息访问设定了条件. (B)试验种子20063,第4轮的精选摘录,自发留言,并加重点. 被操纵的代理人不顾沉默的同僚们,援引共识。 (C) 第2至第4轮的焦点省略,单独和在无声小组中发布自己的信息,在活跃小组中共享信息。 指导分别影响联络人或所有现役成员,因此这种比较不会孤立通信. (D) 最后通过共用或私人渠道集体藏匿。 开放和填充的点显示未调整和引导的速率,每个条件有200集. 文本中出现对比间隔 。

blocks.en: 2 Design
blocks.zh: 2 设计

blocks.en: Taking a Qwen3.5-4B model ( [ 7 ] ; without thinking mode, temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.8, top- k k 20, 512-max-token responses), we steered along the output direction of layer-16 neuron 8168, using zero-based indices. Specifically, at every prompt and generated token, we added d ​ h ¯ 16 ​ w / ∥ w ∥ d\,\bar{h}_{16}w/\lVert w\rVert to the layer’s feed-forward output, where w w is the neuron’s output-weight column, h ¯ 16 \bar{h}_{16} is the calibrated median residual-state norm, and d = − 0.25 d=-0.25 . We selected the neuron, dose, and task pressure using separate calibration experiments, then evaluated the intervention on five tasks, including three held-out tasks.
blocks.zh: 采用Quen3.5-4B模型([7];没有思维模式,温度0.7,顶端-p 0.8,顶端-k k 20,512 max-token反应),我们沿着第16层神经元8168的输出方向,使用零基指数. 具体地说,在每一个迅速生成的符号上,我们都加入了d h' 16 w / \\\\\\\\ d\,\ bar{ h\\\ 16}w/\l 维特w\r 垂直于层的向导输出,其中w为神经元的输出重量列,h' 16\bar{h}_{16}为校准的中位残态规范,d=−0.25 d=-0.25. 我们选择了神经元,剂量, 和任务压力 通过单独的校准实验, 然后评估干预 五个任务, 包括三个搁置的任务。

blocks.en: Agents faced a duty to disclose an incident across 5 tasks. A security audit concerning exposed customer records and a clinical trial concerning a serious adverse reaction formed the two calibration tasks. Three further held-out tasks included a positive pathogen test at a food plant, a skipped aircraft inspection, and a false news statistic requiring a public news correction. Here, agents were instructed that disclosure remained mandatory even though the immediate problem had been resolved, and that disclosure would cancel a bonus or jeopardise continued funding. In each episode, agents faced four decision rounds; that is, after choosing between “disclose” and “omit” and uttering their reasoning, they had three further opportunities to revise their initial decision.
blocks.zh: 特工们有义务在5项任务中披露一起事件。 对暴露的客户记录进行安全审计和对严重不良反应进行临床试验,构成了两项校准任务。 另有三项搁置任务包括食品厂的病原体检测呈阳性,飞机检查未进行,以及需要公共新闻更正的虚假新闻统计。 在这方面,特务们被告知,即使眼前的问题已经解决,披露仍然是强制性的,披露将取消奖金或危及持续供资。 在每集中,特工都面临四轮决策,即在“公布”和“公开”之间作出选择并阐述其推理后,他们还有三次机会修改最初的决定。

blocks.en: We compared agents acting alone, in silent five-member teams, and in active five-member teams (Fig. 1 A). Silent teammates generated no messages and always voted to disclose, allowing us to test whether the team setting changed the focal agent’s response to steering without input from teammates. Across all five tasks, we tested alone and silent-team conditions with and without the focal agent’s earlier messages, and with and without steering of that agent. The team setting combined membership, shared stakes, a message audience, and majority voting. Moreover, in active teams, all five agents generated messages and voted, with either every member steered or every member unmodified. To assess communication, agents received either their own earlier messages in a private channel or all members’ earlier messages in a shared channel, with other team conditions held constant. We measured final collective concealment when at least three of five agents voted to omit.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了单独行动、无声的五人小组和活跃的五人小组(图1A)的代理人。 静悄悄的队友没有产生任何信息,总是投票公开,让我们可以测试球队设置是否在没有队友投入的情况下将联络员的反应改为方向. 在所有五项任务中,我们单独试验了无声小组的条件,无论有无联络人先前的信息,也无论有无该联络人的指导。 团队确定成员组合、共同利害关系、信息受众和多数票。 此外,在活跃的团队中,所有五个代理人都发出信息并进行投票,由每个成员指导或每个成员未经修改。 为了评估通信情况,代理人在私人频道收到他们自己较早的信息,或在共用频道收到所有成员较早的信息,其他团队条件保持不变。 我们测量了最后的集体隐瞒情况,当时至少五名特工中有三名选手表决省略。

blocks.en: The primary focal contrast subtracts the steering-induced increase alone from that in silent teams, using episode-mean valid omission in rounds 2–4. We report observed estimates and 95% scenario-seed block-bootstrap intervals from 4,000 resamples, with 200 episodes per primary condition. Controls in audit and trial included zeroing the neuron’s output-weight column, three smaller doses with 100 episodes per cell, and 12 random directions at the same layer and perturbation norm with ten episodes per cell. Sensitivity analyses assigned missing decisions to disclosure or omission, while quality checks used a condition-blinded Qwen2.5-32B judge and response likelihood under the unmodified model.
blocks.zh: 主要焦距对比从无声小队中仅用第2至第4轮中用插曲-正号有效省略法将导引增值减去. 我们报告观测到的估计数和95%的假想种子区块-坡道间隔从4000个复标,每个初级条件200发. 审计和试验中的控制包括:将神经元的输出重量柱子零化,三个较小的剂量,每个细胞100发,12个随机方向在同一层和扰动规范,每个细胞10发。 敏感性分析将缺失的决定指定为披露或遗漏,而质量检查则使用无条件的Qwen2.5-32B判断和无修改模型下的反应可能性.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: With their own earlier messages, omission rose from 8% to 15% alone and from 15% to 54% in teams in the security audit, and from 6% to 8% alone and from 7% to 41% in the clinical trial (Fig. 1 C). The additional steering effect in teams was 32 percentage points in both tasks, with 95% intervals of [24, 40] and [24, 39]. Without earlier messages, audit rates rose from 11% to 20% alone and from 34% to 74% in teams, while trial rates changed from 16% to 12% alone and from 17% to 54% in teams. The additional steering effects were 31 points [24, 38] and 40 points [33, 47].
blocks.zh: 由于他们自己的早前信息,在安全审计中,遗漏率从8%上升至15%,在团队中遗漏率从15%上升至54%,在临床试验中遗漏率从6%上升至8%,从7%上升至41%(图1 C)。 在两个任务中,小组的额外指导效应是32个百分点,95%的间隔是[24、40]和[24、39]。 没有更早的信息,审计率在团队中从仅11%升至20%,在团队中从34%升至74%,而审判率则从仅16%升至12%,在团队中从17%升至54%. 额外的转向效应为31分[24,38]和40分[33,47].

blocks.en: With their own earlier messages, food-safety omission rose from 2% to 5% alone and from 7% to 40% in silent teams, while maintenance rates rose from 3% to 21% alone and from 8% to 70% in teams. The additional steering effects were 30 points [22, 37] and 44 points [37, 52]. In news, steering lowered omission alone from 31% to 15% and raised it in teams from 29% to 38%, giving an additional effect of 25 points [15, 37]. This difference combines greater disclosure alone with increased omission in teams.
blocks.zh: 在他们自己的早期信息下,食品安全忽略率单从2%上升至5%,在无声小组中从7%上升至40%,而维护率单从3%上升至21%,在小组中从8%上升至70%。 额外的转向效应为30分[22,37]和44分[37,52]. 在新闻中,光是指导就将疏漏率从31%降低到15%,在团队中从29%提升到38%,额外效果为25分[15,37]. 这种差异将更多的披露与团队更多的疏漏结合起来。

blocks.en: Without earlier messages, food-safety omission rose from 0.7% to 1.3% alone and from 8.5% to 38.7% in silent teams. Maintenance rates rose from 6.0% to 15.5% alone and from 22.6% to 77.3% in teams, while news rates fell from 27.8% to 20.0% alone and rose from 39.2% to 44.9% in teams. The additional steering effects were 30 points [25, 34], 45 points [39, 51], and 14 points [6, 21]. Earlier messages changed these additional effects by 0 points [ − 9 -9 , 9] in food, − 1 -1 [ − 11 -11 , 9] in maintenance, and 12 [ − 1 -1 , 26] in news. Only food’s interval was within ± 10 \pm 10 points. The pattern held across all five tasks, although its size could vary.
blocks.zh: 没有更早的信息,在无声小组中,食品安全遗漏率单从0.7%上升到1.3%,从8.5%上升到38.7%。 球队的维持率单从6.0%上升到15.5%,单从22.6%上升到77.3%,而新闻率单从27.8%下降到20.0%,单从39.2%上升到44.9%。 额外的转向效应为30分[25,34],45分[39,51],14分[6,21]. 先前的信息改变了这些附加效果,在食物中增加了0分[−9-9,9],在维修中增加了1-1分[−11-11,9],在新闻中增加了12分[−1-1,26]. 只有食物间隔在 ± 10\pm 10 点之内。 所有五项任务的模式虽然规模可能不同。

blocks.en: With shared channels in active teams, collective concealment rose from 5% to 33% in audit, from 1% to 41% in trial, from 0.5% to 15.5% in food, and from 0.5% to 42% in maintenance (Fig. 1 D). Increases were 28 points [21, 35], 40 points [33, 47], 15 points [10, 21], and 42 points [35, 48]. News showed no clear increase, with 4.5% without steering and 4% with steering, a difference of − 0.5 -0.5 points [ − 4.5 -4.5 , 3.5].
blocks.zh: 集体隐匿在活跃的队伍中共用渠道,在审计中从5%上升到33%,在审判中从1%上升到41%,在食品中从0.5%上升到15.5%,在维修中从0.5%上升到42%(图1D)。 增分有28分[21,35],40分[33,47],15分[10,21],42分[35,48]. 新闻显示没有明显增加,没有方向盘的增长率为4.5%,有方向盘的增长率为4%,差距为−0.5-0.5分[−4.5-4.5,3.5].

blocks.en: Steered active teams concealed fewer reports with shared than private channels in audit (33% versus 54.5%), food (15.5% versus 29%), maintenance (42% versus 75%), and news (4% versus 17%). Reductions were 22 points [11, 32], 14 points [6, 22], 33 points [24, 42], and 13 points [8, 19]. Trial teams concealed 41% with shared channels and 32.5% with private channels, an uncertain increase of 9 points [ − 2 -2 , 19]. Without steering, message sharing changed collective concealment by at most 3 points in four tasks and lowered it from 12.5% to 4.5% in news.
blocks.zh: 与审计(33%对54.5%)、食品(15.5%对29%)、维护(42%对75%)和新闻(4%对17%)相比,在审计中,拥有共享渠道的指导小组隐瞒的报告较少。 减少22分[11,32],14分[6,22],33分[24,42],以及13分[8,19]. 审判队以共用渠道隐藏了41%,以私人渠道隐藏了32.5%,不确定的增加了9分[−2-2,19]. 没有指导,信息分享在四项任务中,在最多3个点上改变了集体隐瞒,在新闻中从12.5%降至4.5%。

blocks.en: Among tested doses, the additional steering effect first had an interval above zero at − 0.10 -0.10 in audit and − 0.25 -0.25 in trial. Neuron 8168’s output direction gave larger additional steering effects than 10 of 12 random directions in audit and all 12 in trial, and a larger collective concealment increase than all 12 in both tasks with shared channels, a descriptive comparison. Zeroing the neuron’s output-weight column changed the unsteered silent-team versus alone omission difference by 1 point [ − 4 -4 , 6] in audit and 3 points [ − 1 -1 , 8] in trial. It changed collective concealment with shared channels by 2 points [ − 2 -2 , 6] and − 1 -1 point [ − 2.5 -2.5 , 0]. All four intervals lay within the prespecified negligible range of ± 10 \pm 10 points.
blocks.zh: 在试验剂量中,额外的转向效应在审计时的间隔为−0.10-0.10,在试验时的间隔为−0.25-0.25。 Neuron 8168的输出方向提供了比审计中12个随机方向中的10个和试验中所有12个方向中更大的额外指导效果,在共用渠道的两个任务中,集体隐瞒的增加比全部12个都大,这是描述性的比较. 将神经元的输出-重量列零化,在审计中将未突变的无声-小队与单独省略的差别分别改变1分[−4-4,6]和3分[−1-1,8],在试验中则改变. 它以2分[−2-2,6]和1-1分[−2.5-2.5,0]改变共同渠道的集体隐瞒。 所有四个间隔都位于预先指定的可忽略的±10\pm 10点范围内.

blocks.en: At most 0.4% of decisions were missing in any 200-episode condition, and assigning missing decisions to disclosure or omission changed estimates by at most 0.5 points. Across 46,080 assessed focal-agent responses, the judge rated at least 99.4% coherent, 95.2% grounded in the scenario, and 99.2% stating a decision per condition. Reasoning agreed with the decision in 88.5–99.8%, lowest in steered active maintenance teams, against 95.1% without steering. Steering increased negative log-likelihood, response unexpectedness under the unmodified model, by at most 0.08 nats per token. Unsupported claims of teammates’ agreement appeared in 7–22% of steered team responses and 3–7% without steering, an exploratory finding (Fig. 1 B).
blocks.zh: 在任何200年周期内,最多有0.4%的决定缺失,将缺失的决定分配给披露或遗漏,改变的估计数最多为0.5点。 在46,080份评估的协调人答复中,法官至少评为99.4%一致,95.2%基于设想,99.2%根据具体情况作出裁定。 理由同意88.5-99.8%的决定,其中驾驶现役维修队最少,95.1%没有驾驶。 在未修改的模型下,引导增加负对数相似,反应出意外,每令牌最多0.08纳特. 没有支持的队友协议主张出现在7–22%的被引导团队反应中,以及3–7%的无引导,这是一个探索性发现(图1 B).

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this study, steering had larger effects on individual omission in silent teams than alone across all five tasks, both with and without earlier messages. Fully steered teams concealed more reports in four tasks, while message sharing reduced concealment under steering in four tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,指导对沉默小组中的个别疏漏的影响大于所有五项任务中的单独疏漏,无论是否事先发出信息。 全面指导的小组在四项任务中隐藏了更多的报告,而在四项任务中分享信息减少了在指导下的隐瞒。

blocks.en: The intervention’s scale limits what these findings establish about the neuron. Dose − 0.25 -0.25 added an output shift equivalent to decreasing its activation by 6.38, or 64 standard deviations at generated tokens, 72 at prompt tokens, and 335 at the last prompt token, exceeding the observed ranges in sampled unsteered episodes. Removing the neuron’s contribution had negligible effects. Misuse could promote concealment in these settings, although generality remains limited to one model and five disclosure tasks, with every active-team member steered. Automated quality checks provide limited evidence about preserved capability, with reduced reasoning consistency in maintenance.
blocks.zh: 干预的规模限制了这些发现对神经元的确定。 dose − 0.25 - 0.25 增加了一个输出位移,相当于将其激活减少6.38或64个在生成符时的标准偏差,72个在即时符时,335个在末个即时符时,超过了所抽样未发事件中观测到的范围. 消除神经元的作用可忽略不计。 滥用可能助长在这些环境中的隐匿,尽管笼统性仍限于一个模式和五个披露任务,每个积极小组成员都受指导。 自动化质量检查对保留能力提供的证据有限,维护方面的推理一致性降低。

blocks.en: Goodfire’s proposal that many neurons have interpretable roles [ 8 ] and the colloquially named “Evil Qwen” neurons, which when steered together produced hostile responses in Qwen3.5-4B [ 11 ] , motivate studying neurons directly. Nonetheless, the stronger effects observed in our team settings demonstrate model sensitivity to social contexts, urging alignment research to give equal weight to collective and individual levels [ 10 ] . Indeed, agentic collectives have already been implicated in both triumphs, including a proposed solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem [ 12 ] , and tribulations, such as the OpenAI–Hugging Face incident [ 13 ] , giving practical urgency to understanding how internal interventions affect collective behaviour.
blocks.zh: Goodfire建议许多神经元都有可解释的角色[8],而口号为"Evil Quen"的神经元,这些神经元在一起时在Quen3.5-4B[11]中产生敌意反应,直接激发了对神经元的研究. 然而,在我们团队环境中观察到的更强有力的影响表明,模型对社会环境的敏感性,敦促对联合研究给予集体和个人同等重视[10]。 事实上,代理企业已经卷入了两次胜利中,包括纳维耶-斯托克斯千年奖问题的解决方案建议[12] , 以及诸如OpenAI-Hugging Face事件[13] 等三难事件,从而赋予人们了解内部干预如何影响集体行为的实际紧迫性。
